label.zh: espionage.2 每次抽取至多一个
label.en: espionage.2 draws at most one per pulse

note.zh: 权重：无事80，被弃特工2（有被弃特工标志时×3），隐形2（仅格式塔），意外收获2（需有宿敌），截获1、1，阴谋曝光1（有高级加密、守护者/皇帝/危机派系则减半，无加密2则×2）。1081占90%、1082占10%。 （espionage.1040 “意外收获”也由行动事件触发，已归入行动类故事，此处不列。）
note.en: Weights: nothing 80, disavowed operative 2 (x3 with the disavowed flag), vivid sight 2 (gestalt only), surprise catch 2 (needs a nemesis), intercepts 1 and 1, plot exposed 1 (halved with advanced encryption or galactic office/crisis faction, doubled without encryption 2). 1081 takes 90%, 1082 10%. (espionage.1040, the surprise catch, is also fired by operation events and lives in the operation stories, so it is not listed here.)

notes.zh: 被弃特工线由隐藏事件 1000 在360天后触发 1001；选项“无视”经1005，选项“救出”经1020；事件链 operative_resurfaces_chain 与隐藏 1025（1080天后）一并启动。
notes.en: The disavowed-operative line starts from hidden 1000, which fires 1001 after 360 days; "ignore" goes through 1005, "extract" through 1020; the event chain operative_resurfaces_chain and hidden 1025 (after 1080 days) start with it.

scope.zh: 间谍活动的随机事件池：被弃特工重现、隐形、意外收获、截获、阴谋曝光。
scope.en: Espionage random event pool: disavowed operative resurfaces, vivid sight, surprise catch, intercepts, exposed plots.

uncertain: Events 1070-1073 (fired from operation events) belong to the espionage-operations stories owned by another reviewer.
